summary: AZZ Inc. filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, reporting that its Board of Directors declared a fiscal 2027 second-quarter cash dividend of $0.24 per share on outstanding common stock. The dividend is payable November 5, 2026, to holders of record as of the close of business October 19, 2026. No advisor, premium, stake, or transaction terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine dividend declaration under Item 8.01, not a special situation; the press release notes future dividends remain subject to board discretion. No risk-arb angle applies.
